newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Sept 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Sept 9.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page.

WASHINGTON - The Potomac River gushed at 130 times its normal rate, overwhelming its banks and destroying many of the repairs made to the C&O Canal after another massive flood hit the Washinton area eight months ago.
SALAHUDDIN, IRAQ - About 200 Iraqi Arabs who have connections to the CIA-supported opposition to President Saddam Hussein say they are convinced they will be killed by Iraq's secret police.
WASHINGTON - Gang affiliations play a powerful role in young people's lives, even behind bars in prisons around the country.
WASHINGTON - The Redskins are keeping fans on the edges of their seats with near wins and near losses.
WASHINGTON - Law enforcement officials say that deadly crimes, more often associated with the sale of crack cocaine, have become a routine part of the marijuana trade.
